newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND'S REMAK SA TO SHED 50 MORE STAFF.
newsitem.headline: POLAND'S REMAK SA TO SHED 50 MORE STAFF.

text.p: Remak SA will lay off 50 more employees, or about 10 percent of its workforce, to lower costs and reduce operating losses, the Polish engineering firm's Vice President said on Tuesday.
In April Remak announced it would shed 50 workers, 46 of which have now left, and Aleksandra Kowalska said that in mid-June it had 524 employees.

Kowalska told Reuters that in all the lay-offs would affect 120 people as the firm, which restores and assembles energy equipment, aimed to limit production and adjust its size to suit its potential market.

"Our intention was to dismiss 120 people...but this had to be spread out over time," she said, adding that the gradual approach was designed to avoid lay-offs of more than 10 percent at one time which would have increased costs.
